messages:
Anya P: Noticed deterministic divergence between fp16 and int4 builds when running very long prefill (>12k tokens). Same seed, same prompt, different continuation after token ~12290.
Miguel: Short repro?
Anya P: Minimal repro (canary int4 build):
```
export MODEL=magnet-13b-q3f
./run_infer --prefill-file long_demo.txt --max-tokens 4000 --dump-kv-checksum pre/post
```
Log snip: 
```
[13:45:01] PREFILL len=14352 shards=4 kv_index_end=12288
[13:45:02] EVICT prefix_window=8192 -> evict(4096..8191)
[13:45:02] KV_CHECKSUM pre=0x7a1f2b89 post=0x9c4d3e01 mismatch
[13:45:02] TOKEN_DIFF pos=12290 expected="," got="."
```
Disabling prefix cache removes the divergence.
Sasha: Can we dump KV entries around the boundary with KV_DEBUG so we can diff int4 vs fp16 keys/values?
Anya P: Dump attached (trimmed):
```
# kv entries 12288..12292
int4: kv_key(12288)=0x1b2c3d4e kv_val=0x5a6b7c8d
fp16: kv_key(12288)=0x1b2c3d4f kv_val=0x5a6b7c8d
```
Only LSB differs in the key mapping. Suggests RoPE index mapping shifted by one on quantized path.
Samir: We saw a related thing during int4 bring-up: the quant kernel applied index normalization slightly differently (order of ops) which can change rounding near integer boundaries, especially after eviction/reinsertion.
Miguel: Hypothesis: when pos*scale is very close to an integer, float truncation in the quant kernel vs fp16 kernel leads to floor() returning different integers, yielding different KV keys after eviction.
Sasha: Quick mitigation idea: add a tiny epsilon in the int4 path when computing discrete rotary index: `idx = floor(pos*scale + 1e-6)` instead of `floor(pos*scale)`. Can someone test `--force-rope-epsilon=1e-6`?
Anya P: Tested. With epsilon=1e-6 keys align and completions match for the sample.
Miguel: Perf impact?
Anya P: Microbench: ~3% CPU on kernel overhead, p50 +4ms on short sequences, negligible at p99 for long sequences.
Samir: We should add deterministic unit tests for token boundaries around shard/window edges (e.g., tokens 8190..8196) comparing kv checksums across quant modes and fp16, plus a fuzz job that randomly evicts/writes keys.
Miguel: I'll open INF ticket and roll a canary. INF-3421: "rope-index rounding epsilon for quant kernels".
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: canary/2023-11-14-09:30 1 nodes 1 patch `rope-epsilon-quant-fix`.
Sasha: Also add to onboarding checklist: long-prefill (>12k) smoke for any quantized variant. These regressions only show up when longprefill + shard-evict occur.
Anya P: Added test harness + goldens under `tests/long_prefill/goldens/magnet13b/`. PR incoming.
Miguel: Plan: 1) ship epsilon flag behind runtime flag, 2) add unit + fuzz tests, 3) run full quant-bench across 5 seeds and long-prefill corpus, 4) promote if stable after 24h canary.
Samir: Longer term: consider making rotary index mapping integer-stable (avoid fp path-dependent rounding) but thats a deeper refactor.
Anya P: Uploaded diffs + small sample audio clip of failing prompt for product. Patch + smoke looks good. :thumbsup:
Miguel: Thanks team. Monitor `kv-checksum-mismatch` and `lockstep-token-diff` metrics during canary. @Sasha please own the tests.
Sasha: On it 1 will add the fuzz job to the CI matrix.
Anya P: Gist with quick repro: https://gist.github.com/redwood/ef12ab34
